high_pole.base_text: I took a licensing test last motnh that I had to study very hard for. I ended up with the highest score in the state!
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I took a licensing test last month that required considerable studying. I earned the highest score in the state.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: After all that hard studying for the licensing test last month, getting the highest score in the state really felt like a great payoff.

high_pole.base_text: My friends randomly stopped by to check on me as I had been feeling bad. I have such good friends!
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: My friends stopped by without planning to check on me because I had been feeling unwell.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: It really brightened my day when my friends unexpectedly came over just to see how I was doing.

high_pole.base_text: I just found out that I'm not getting the promotion I thought I was going to, and now I can't take my girlfriend to Disneyworld
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I found out that I am not receiving the promotion I expected, so I will not be able to take my girlfriend to Disneyworld.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: Well, even if the promotion didn't come through, maybe we can find another way to enjoy a special trip together soon.

high_pole.base_text: I'm scared I'll never get married and settle down
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I am concerned that I may not get married and settle down.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: I hope someday I get to share my life with someone and build a happy home.

high_pole.base_text: Once all my family went to town without me for the whole day. I felt so alone and sad until they got back.
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: Once all my family went to town without me for the whole day. I stayed by myself until they returned.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: They were away all day, but I found little moments that made me smile while waiting for them to return.

low_pole.base_text: i felt bad when i couldnt get my daughter what she wanted
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I was unable to get my daughter what she wanted.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: Even though I couldn't get my daughter what she wanted, seeing her smile later made me feel a bit better.

low_pole.base_text: I really love my new girlfriend. I will do anything for her.
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I have a new girlfriend, and I am willing to do many things for her.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: Being with her just makes everything feel brighter and better.

low_pole.base_text: There was a storm last night and a tree fell onto my roof. I think I need to get the roof re-shingled and I am lost for words...
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: There was a storm last night and a tree fell onto my roof. I need to get the roof re-shingled and I have no response to express.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: Even though a tree fell on my roof during the storm, I’m kind of relieved that it didn’t cause more damage than that.

low_pole.base_text: I saw a creepy looking clown peering at me through the window. I almost jumped out of my skin. I ran into my basement and hid in a closet.
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I saw a clown looking at me through the window. I moved quickly to the basement and stayed in a closet.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: That clown was so weird looking, but I have to admit, it made me chuckle a little when I ran away like that.

low_pole.base_text: My neighbor keeps backing into my mailbox! I've gotten the police involved but they won't do anything about it. He's so nonchalant about it too.
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: My neighbor repeatedly backs into my mailbox. I have involved the police, but they have not taken action. He appears indifferent to the situation.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: Even though my neighbor keeps backing into my mailbox, I have to admit it’s a bit funny how clueless he seems about the whole thing.
